findings.evidence: Both proofs contain the identical subterm `Function.notMem_support.1 fun h => hy (hρS h)` (lines 252 and 267) feeding `Set.le_indicator`.
findings.fix: Factor a private lemma `le_indicator_const_of_support_subset {f : E → ℝ} (hfS : Function.support f ⊆ S) (hfM : ∀ y, f y ≤ M) (y : E) : f y ≤ S.indicator (fun _ => M) y`, and apply it with `f := fun y => |ρ y|` (its support equals `Function.support ρ`) in `integrableOn_Ici_comp_add_smul` and with `f := ρ` in `densityWeightedPathLength_le_mul_geometricPathLength`.
findings.issue: The pointwise bound `ρ y ≤ S.indicator (fun _ => M) y` from `Function.support ρ ⊆ S` is proved twice, as nested anonymous-lambda terms: lines 250-252 (`Set.le_indicator (f := fun y => |ρ y|) ... (fun y hy => by simp [Function.notMem_support.1 fun h => hy (hρS h)])`) and lines 266-268 (`Set.le_indicator (fun y _ => hρM y) (fun y hy => (Function.notMem_support.1 fun h => hy (hρS h)).le)`). The shared off-support reasoning is repeated and both occurrences are hard to read.

findings.evidence: Line 283's comment states the defeq ("The section of `hset` at `p` is, by definition, `pathParameters S p.1 p.2`") but no lemma or rewrite makes it a step; line 289-293 has no comment at all. The same implicit unfolding also carries `geometricPathLength_nonneg` (line 140) and `densityWeightedPathLength_nonneg` (line 148), which is harmless one-step delta, unlike the two measurability proofs.
findings.fix: In `measurable_geometricPathLength`, name the section explicitly: `have hsec : ∀ p : E × E, Prod.mk p ⁻¹' {q : (E × E) × ℝ | 0 ≤ q.2 ∧ q.1.1 + q.2 • q.1.2 ∈ S} = pathParameters S p.1 p.2 := fun _ => rfl`, then `simp only [hsec]` before `exact`. In `measurable_densityWeightedPathLength`, start with `simp only [densityWeightedPathLength_def]`.
findings.issue: `measurable_geometricPathLength` closes with `exact (measurable_measure_prodMk_left hset).ennreal_toReal`, which unifies only by unfolding `Prod.mk p ⁻¹' {q | 0 ≤ q.2 ∧ q.1.1 + q.2 • q.1.2 ∈ S}` into the set-builder body of `pathParameters` — a defeq the file otherwise avoids by routing through `geometricPathLength_def`/`pathParameters_eq_preimage_inter`. The same silent delta occurs at line 292, where `measurable_densityWeightedPathLength` matches `densityWeightedPathLength` by unfolding it with no `densityWeightedPathLength_def` rewrite and no comment.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust and well commented, but the "bounded density supported in S is pointwise below the indicator" argument is duplicated verbatim in two dense term-mode proofs, and the two measurability proofs close their goals by silent delta-unfolding instead of the `_def` lemmas the file otherwise uses.
